subject: POC trial environment options and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC trial environment options and next steps

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the call earlier — good to align on Acme AI's primary goals for the POC. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can move to scheduling: 

Call recap / priorities:
- Primary success criteria: 1) Intent classification accuracy >= 92% on Acme's support dataset (we'll run the evaluation script), 2) End-to-end latency p95 < 400ms for 2kQPS burst profile, 3) Integration with your data connectors (S3 + internal KB) and no data persist beyond session.
- Constraints: must validate on a production-adjacent dataset; security team prefers a VPC trial but procurement will flag cost and timeline.

Environment options (high level):
1) Hosted Redwood (fastest onboarding) — quick to spin up, lower admin overhead, ideal if you want to start running evals tomorrow with sample data.
2) Dedicated sandbox (reserved capacity) — predictable throughput, better isolation, good middle ground for throughput tests without full VPC networking.
3) VPC trial (customer-managed network) — required for full security sign-off and to run against private data sources; longer lead time due to networking and KMS/HSM setup.

Proposed evaluation plan / timeline:
- Week 0: sign-off on scope + access (Procurement + Security).
- Week 1: Hosted or Dedicated sandboxes for functional tests and initial eval runs.
- Week 2-3: If VPC is chosen, complete VPC onboarding and run the final production-adjacent tests.

Ownership:
- Marissa (me): overall POC PM and timeline coordination.
- Vivek: technical onboarding (network, keys, VLANs) and run throughput/latency validation.
- Rishi: commercial terms and contract/DocuSign coordination.
- Acme (Samir): provide evaluation dataset, procurement contact, and security requirements.

Attachments: redwood-poc-template.pdf (POC success criteria template) attached for you to review.

Next steps (please reply):
- Confirm preferred environment (Hosted / Dedicated / VPC).
- Provide procurement contact and target start date.
- Any immediate blockers from Security?

Thanks — happy to hop on a 30m sync if helpful.

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Samir Shah <samir@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Mar 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC trial environment options and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the detailed recap. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Security preference: our InfoSec team strongly prefers VPC trials for any work involving customer PII. Is there a minimal VPC onboarding checklist you can share?
2) Timeline: ideally we'd like a 3-week window to validate. Can you confirm whether the Hosted option can be used at all for initial validation while VPC is being stood up, or do you recommend waiting for VPC?
3) Cost: any ballpark for a 3-week VPC trial vs Dedicated sandbox? Procurement will need estimates.
4) KPIs: the accuracy metric is fine. Do you have a sample eval script we can run locally before we share the full dataset?

Looping in procurement: procurement@acme.ai

Thanks — Samir
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@acme.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC trial environment options and next steps

Samir — great questions, answers below and a concrete proposal to keep momentum: 

1) VPC onboarding checklist: attached vpc-onboarding-checklist.xlsx — covers network requirements, IP allowlists, KMS setup, and expected lead time (typically 7–10 business days once network/config approvals are in place).
2) Hosted while VPC is stood up: yes — we recommend starting with Hosted for functional evals and running our local eval script with a redacted subset if you prefer. This lets you validate the integration and model behavior while the networks are configured.
3) Cost estimates (ballpark for planning):
   - 3-week Hosted: minimal — primarily usage-based; we can provide detailed estimates once you share expected token volumes.
   - 3-week Dedicated sandbox: ~$6k–$12k depending on instance size and throughput (reserved for the window).
   - 3-week VPC trial: ~$12k–$25k including dedicated infra and networking support (higher due to managed private connectivity and KMS).
4) Eval script: here's a link to a lightweight eval harness you can run locally: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1evalscript. We'll also share a sample redacted dataset you can use for the initial runs.

Proposed execution (if you agree):
- Thu 5 Mar: sign-off on scope and procurement contact.
- Week of 8 Mar: start Hosted functional tests + scheduling for VPC network kickoff.
- Week of 15 Mar: VPC onboarding complete and run production-adjacent tests.

Owners reiterated:
- Marissa: POC PM / status updates.
- Vivek: VPC/Dedicated technical lead.
- Rishi: commercial / DocuSign.
- Naomi: Customer Success check-ins and rollout planning.

Next actions for Acme to unblock:
- Confirm target start date and environment preference.
- Provide procurement contact and any required PO workflow info.

If that sounds good I can draft the DocuSign for the POC engagement and share a short kickoff agenda.

--
Marissa
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 11:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC trial environment options and next steps

Marissa / Rishi — quick internal note: we have capacity to stand up a Dedicated sandbox next week and prelim network engineers available for the VPC kickoff on the 10th. I can own the VPC checklist items and KMS setup with Acme's infra team.

Estimated infra work: 2–3 business days for Dedicated sandbox provisioning and 6–8 business days for VPC (network approvals + KMS config). I'll schedule a technical kickoff once we get final confirmation from Samir.

Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Samir Shah <samir@acme.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement <procurement@acme.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC trial environment options and next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear plan. Acme is aligned to proceed with a VPC trial (we need the full security posture validated). Proposed start date: 2026-03-10, 3-week window. Procurement (procurement@acme.ai) will review the DocuSign and follow up on PO/terms.

Confirmed success criteria: accuracy >= 92% on our validation set; p95 latency < 400ms for our expected bursts; no data persistence beyond session.

Next steps for Redwood: please send the DocuSign + VPC checklist and proposed kickoff time next week. I'll loop in our infra lead once I have the checklist.

Thanks — Samir
